title: Turning tracking off hides and clears Min/Max, total updates at once
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. A tracked part with Min/Max set and holding zero on hand.
custom_steps:
1. Turn tracking off and confirm Min/Max hide; save and reopen to confirm they cleared.
  2. Confirm the Total Quantity column updates without a reload.
  3. Turn tracking ON, remove all bin locations and try to save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Turning tracking off hides the Min and Max fields and clears their values on save; after save the Total Quantity column shows the new tracking state without a reload.
  • Turning tracking ON but removing all bin locations before saving shows "At least one bin must be provided."

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 5 (Edit tracking state); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R6: “When the user turns tracking off, the Min and Max fields are hidden.”
  • S5-R7: “When the user turns tracking off, the Min and Max values are cleared on save.”
  • S5-R8: “After a successful save, the Total Quantity column shows the new tracking state without the user reloading the page.”
  • S5-N1: “If the user turns tracking ON but removes all bin locations before saving, the system displays: "At least one bin must be provided."”
